Two one-cycle pulses, not held levels: `assign events_o[0] = s_int_tx | s_int_rx;` (the TX/RX threshold event generated for one cycle in GEN_INT_TX/GEN_INT_RX, apb_spi_master.sv:116,179-183,220-224) and `assign events_o[1] = s_eot;` (the end-of-transfer pulse registered in spi_master_controller.sv:455). This project's interrupt controller admits level sources only, so the profile declares no interrupt_source endpoint and exports both bits for observation instead of inventing a level hold the RTL does not have. The matching status path is also non-level: REG_INTSTA (0x28) has no read-mux arm, so it reads 0 and the read itself only re-arms the TX/RX event state machine (spi_master_apb_if.sv:82,210-211).
